tone_statements.citation: Ngabut, C. Yus; Turangan, Max; Mihing, Samuel. 1992. Struktur Bahasa Tawoyan. Jakarta: Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan (Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa). x+61 pp.
tone_statements.quote: 2.5 Fonem Suprasegmental. Dari data yang terkumpul. ternyata bahasa Tawoyan tidak mempunyai fonem suprasegmental atau ciri prosodi lainnya. ... [Bab V Kesimpulan, p. 49:] Fonem-fonem ini diidentifikasi setelah melalui pengontrasan pasangan minimal. Selain itu, dalam bahasa Tawoyan tidak dijumpai fonem suprasegmental ataupun ciri-ciri prosodi lainnya.
tone_statements.translation: 2.5 Suprasegmental phonemes. From the data collected, it turns out that Tawoyan has no suprasegmental phonemes or other prosodic features. ... [Ch. V Conclusion:] These phonemes were identified through contrasting minimal pairs. In addition, in Tawoyan no suprasegmental phonemes or other prosodic features are found.
tone_statements.locator: p. 15, section 2.5 Fonem Suprasegmental and p. 49, Bab V Kesimpulan
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
tone_statements.summary: Blanket statement that Tawoyan has no suprasegmental phonemes (so no distinctive tone or stress); 1.4 says suprasegmentals were sought from recordings of speech. No data or discussion beyond this.
